message.content:
## Recent developments
* **DOJ Scrutiny of NVIDIA Acquisition:** In late October 2026, the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) initiated inquiries into NVIDIA’s reported $12.93 billion acquisition of Hugging Face. Regulators are examining how the deal might impact AI market competition, specifically focusing on NVIDIA controlling a central open-model distribution hub.
* **Executive Leadership and Strategic Defense:** CEO Clem Delangue and cofounders have publicly addressed the shifting landscape—vowing to fiercely protect the open-source and open-weight AI ecosystem amidst high-profile industry consolidation.
* **ProtoStar Open Science Initiative:** Hugging Face recently launched "ProtoStar," a major academic partnership initiative alongside university networks (such as the Open Forum for AI). The project aims to accelerate open science, highlighted by the inaugural Climate Risk Intelligence challenge hosted at Carnegie Mellon University in November 2026.

## Talking points
* **Regulatory Compliance & Strategy:** Inquire about the current status of the DOJ inquiry into the NVIDIA transaction and how it affects Hugging Face's day-to-day operations and developer trust.
* **Open-Source Integrity:** Discuss how leadership plans to maintain neutrality, independence, and open access for developers across the hub if major hardware or tech giants deepen their financial stakes.
* **Growth in Scientific AI:** Highlight the momentum behind ProtoStar and the massive surge in fully documented science dataset sharing on the platform through 2026.

## Open questions
* How is the DOJ inquiry progressing, and what specific concessions or structural remedies are being discussed?
* What assurances are being given to the developer community regarding neutrality and access post-acquisition?
* How does Hugging Face plan to scale the ProtoStar academic initiative following its inaugural climate challenge at CMU?

## Sources
* [Nvidia + Hugging Face: 5 DOJ Probe Risks [2026]](https://shattered.io/nvidia-hugging-face-doj-inquiry-12-93b-meta-becerra-pac-2026)
* [Hugging Face cofounder: Open-weight AI models were 'our savior'](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/hugging-face-cofounder-open-weight-ai-models-were-our-savior-220000916.html)
* [Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open-source AI after Jensen Huang’s exit](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/12/hugging-face-ceo-vows-to-keep-fighting-for-open-source-ai-after-jensen-huangs-exit)
* [Hugging Face launches ProtoStar open science and AI initiative](https://www.edtechinnovationhub.com/news/hugging-face-and-universities-launch-protostar-to-put-public-research-to-work-with-ai)
* [CMU to Host Challenge to Put Scientific Data to Work With AI](https://www.cmu.edu/news/stories/archives/2026/october/cmu-to-host-challenge-to-put-scientific-data-to-work-with-ai)
